description_en: Deletes the episode list for carousel playback in a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-caster-program --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCasterProgram

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID.

The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio. You can use this ID as a request parameter when you add, delete, or modify episodes for the production studio
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为添加导播台节目、删除导播台节目、修改导播台节目的请求参数
